variants.headline: The bag that gets passed round the office
variants.body: Baked red lentil crisps made for sharing. Fair warning: it won't come back.
variants.rationale: Round-1 human winner (66% tap intent, n 47), re-tested unchanged as the control.

variants.headline: The office crisp with 13g protein
variants.body: Baked red lentil crisps that get passed round the office. Protein on the label, crunch in the bag.
variants.rationale: Keeps the winning social-proof frame (66%) and adds the protein fact the AI over-rated (AI 71% vs room 47%), to test whether health helps inside the winning frame.

variants.headline: The 4pm bag everyone reaches for
variants.body: Sea salt lentil crisps, baked not fried. Bring one to the meeting and watch it go.
variants.rationale: Combines the top two levers from round 1: social proof (66%) and indulgence (57%).
